My instructions say to "Use aliases only when they are clear and non-ambiguous." Therefore, I'll discard "Star Trek franchise" and instead use ["Star Trek replicator"] as a more appropriate and unambiguous alias.

Again, all these surface questions should lead to the expected answer "replicator".
